title: Aftergraph AVC Dissolution Ledger
description: EXPERIMENTAL avc-dissolution contract for the Wave I AVC-retirement slice. A dissolution record is ledger-owned evidence that an AVC identity moved to a disposition of MIGRATED_VERIFIED/MIGRATED_TRANSITIONAL/EXTRACT/RETIRE/HISTORY_ONLY, pinned to extraction baseline 18317c7b2eebcc08bb2a1b30d9118935d5832540 with a delta-audit ref. No AVC identity retires while an active consumer or a canonical-doc ownership ref still names it; retirement asserted outside the ledger rejects. No newly-minted avc-/@avc-scoped/AVC identifier is ever active. Archive-gate refs are references only: governance pins ledger, gates, and vectors and NEVER executes archival or deletion; the final legacy-repo archive action REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION. Owner-execution and extraction-completion claims are evidence-gated on owner evidence. Skill/Hermes migration records carry skills-vault target ownership, an Aftergraph canonical identifier with retained legacy alias/provenance, zero canonical skills owned by AVC, and non-empty skills-vault-side registry and evidence refs; persona/product-specific skills generalize or retire; Hermes reconciliation is evidenced; migration-completion claims are evidence-gated on owner execution evidence.

archive_gate_ref.description: Reference to the owner-held archive gate; a reference only, never an archival execution.

executes_archival.description: True executes archival/deletion and always rejects; governance never executes archival.

skill_class.description: Skill migration subject class; presence marks the record as a skill/Hermes migration record.

canonical_identifier.description: Aftergraph canonical identifier of the migrated skill; never a newly-minted avc-/@avc/ identifier.

generalization_ref.description: Reference proving a persona/product-specific skill was generalized; empty means carried over verbatim.

ledger_skill_owner.description: Skill owner as currently shown by the ledger.

asserts_canonical_ownership.description: True asserts canonical skill ownership for the migration target.

canonical_skills_owned_by_avc.description: Canonical skills still owned by AVC; a migration PASS shows zero.

canonical_contract_owner.description: Owner of the canonical contract in a migration PASS claim; never AVC.

skills_vault_registry_refs.description: Non-empty skills-vault registry refs required for a skill migration accept.

skills_vault_evidence_refs.description: Non-empty skills-vault-side evidence refs; legacy-repo self-attestation alone never proves migration.

attestation_source.description: Party attesting the migration; legacy-repo alone is self-attestation.

claims_migration_complete.description: Live migration-completion claim, evidence-gated on owner execution evidence.
